texto: «Ik ben allergisch voor...» is used to communicate an allergy (I am allergic to...). Essential substances are «pinda» (peanuts) and «noten» (nuts in general). To verify the safety of a processing, the waiter is asked: «Kunt u dat controleren bij de kok?» (can you check with the cook?).

frases.nl: Dank u dat u het zegt.
analisis: that you say it; to say it.

frases.nl: Zit er pinda in deze saus?
Ik controleer het bij de kok.
Dank u. Ik wacht even op uw antwoord.
frases.es: Gracias. Esperaré un momento su respuesta.
frases.en: Thank you. I'll wait a moment for your answer.

bloques.pregunta: With what preposition is the «allergisch» adjective combined in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: «allergisch voor» («allergisch voor pinda's/noten») is always said.
«met» is not used to govern the object of the allergy.
«In» expresses inner location, not the causing allergic.

bloques.pregunta: What action does the employee take to the client question?
bloques.frase: Ik controleer het bij de kok.

opciones.texto: You will consult the cook directly in the kitchen.
opciones.explicacion: «Controleren bij de kok» is to check with the chef.

opciones.texto: Make sure the sauce is totally safe without checking anything.
opciones.explicacion: He says he's gonna confirm it with the cook first.

opciones.texto: He advises you not to eat anything and leave the place.
opciones.explicacion: He's acting professionally and he's gonna check in the kitchen.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the fixed preposition that governs the allergy adjective.

opciones.explicacion: «Op» would be used for «wachten op», not for allergies.
It is not the right preposition in this medical locution.

bloques.pregunta: What specific ingredient causes customer problems?

opciones.explicacion: He doesn't mention problems with gluten, but with peanuts.
Ask for pinda, not for dairy products.

bloques.pregunta: What attitude does the client show while the employee goes to the kitchen?
bloques.frase: Dank u. Ik wacht even op uw antwoord.

opciones.texto: He is waiting patiently for the confirmation of the staff.
opciones.explicacion: «Ik wacht even» indicates that you will wait for the answer before eating.

opciones.texto: Cancel immediately all your order without waiting
opciones.explicacion: Decides to wait for the employee to return with the answer.

opciones.texto: Try a tablespoon of salsa to check if you feel bad
opciones.explicacion: It does not take unnecessary risks.

bloques.pregunta: Complete to ask if the condiment or dressing is peanuts.

opciones.explicacion: Although there has been talk of soups, here you ask for «deze saus».

bloques.explicacion: Subject, copulative verb, adjective with preposition and plural allergic.

intro: It clearly reports food allergies and asks staff to consult in the kitchen.
